demolition:
{{Breadcrumb Auto|parent=Damage}}
Separate from Damage, the '''Demolition Force''' of an attack determines if said attack can destroy a structure.

== Demolition Force & Structures ==
All destructible structures in- game have a Demolition Threshold between 10 and 60.

In order to destroy a structure, the user needs to be using a weapon/stratagem that has enough Demolition Force. Explosions have demolition force fall-off in the outer radius. Armor penetration is irrelevant to this check, as is damage, and whether or not the attack is explosive. When the threshold is met, the structure will be destroyed. 

The exceptions to this are enemy spawners; [[Bug Hole|Bug Holes]], [[Automaton Fabricator|Automaton Fabricators]], [[Bulk Fabricator|Bulk Fabricators]] and [[Grounded Warp Ship|Grounded Warp Ships]], which require a '''minimum''' demo force of '''20''' and the ''explosive'' property to destroy via their open hole, vent and door; as they have '''B'''allistic '''D'''emolition '''R'''esistance, or BaDR. Ballistic Demolition Resistance means that the structure(s) resists demo force from non-explosive projectiles such as bullets or electric arcs. For example, an [[E/MG-101 HMG Emplacement]] which has a demo force of 20, but is not explosive. Therefore, it will not destroy the structure.

Note: Certain structures such as [[Spore Spewer|Spore Spewers]] and [[Shrieker Nest|Shrieker Nests]], are not labeled as structures that require demo force to destroy. These entities are considered non-moving enemy units with low Armor Value, high HP, and Durability. The only exceptions to this are Automaton Fabricators, Bulk Fabricators and Grounded Warp Ships, which use both health, armor, and demolition force systems.

{{Breadcrumb Auto|parent=Places of Interest}}

{{Quote|Missions are filled with unexplored points of interest. Check them out -- you never know what you might find.|[[Training Manual Tips]]}}

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (m'''POI''') are minor locations scattered around on Expedition-mission<ref>Expedition-mission being random-generated-maps, I.E. not fixed [[Eradicate]] or [[Evacuate High-Value Assets|Evacuation]]-mission-maps.</ref> maps containing various items of value, some depending on the [[difficulty]] level.

These are not to be confused with [[Galaxy Places of Interest]].

__FORCETOC__
== Locations and Icons ==
{{PAGENAME}}s can be found in multiple ways:
* All mPOIs are displayed onto the topographical minimap. Spotting or otherwise recognizing some of the mPOIs can be tricky due the numerous variations of the topographical drawings varying between different [[biomes]] or otherwise having different randomly selected sharpness and other quality variations.
* The compass displays a question mark ("?") when Helldiver is within 60-metres radius of undiscovered mPOI-markers; this mark functions identically to pinged locations being bright while in field-of-view and transparent at the edges of the compass.
* Completing the [[Radar Station|Radar Station side objective]] highlights all POIs on the map.
* Occasionally the marking-cursor on the mini-map can reveal some (and very rarely all mPOIs) with a '''''Minor Place of Interest''''' text-pop-up. NOTE: This method becomes functional only after first playing an expedition-type (not [[Eradicate]] or [[Evacuate High-Value Assets|Defence]])-mission during each gameplay-session / ".exe-boot".

When found, the icons of {{PAGENAME}}s will change on the minimap if it was sufficiently looted of all samples (ammunition and [[Support Weapons]] generally do not count):
* [[File:POI Unplundered Icon.png|50px]] Contains [[Samples]] / un-explored mPOI.
* [[File:POI Plundered Icon.png|50px]]Does not contain [[Samples]]/all [[Samples]] collected.
An exception to note is that if there was a Rescue Pod at the mPOI, and it did not contain a [[Support Weapon]], then the icon will not change from the gem after successful looting, even if all [[Sample|Samples]] and [[currency]] have been collected. If it did contain a Support Weapon, then it will change after picking it up. This is unique to Rescue Pods, and does not apply to [[Underground Cache|Underground Caches]] or other types of mPOIs. 

=== Guards at mPOIs ===
On {{Difficulty|4}} and above, enemies can be present at most {{PAGENAME}}s. On {{Difficulty|7}} and above, enemies can occupy them, along with their appearances changing, such as adding structures like [[Environmental Hazards|Barbed Wire]] or [[Cannon Turret]]s.

=== Minor Places of Interest Within Cities ===
The generation of mPOIs within [[Cities| colonies / cities]] has some exceptions: 

* All eligible mPOI candidate "tiles" will be generated regardless of if they end up being a mPOI or not, such "Checkpoints" and "Customs / Shipping Container Platforms".
** This rule allows a chance of colony-tileset being the most densely populated by mPOIs. E.G. There can be several Rescue Pods placed within few steps of each other due to the small surface-area-requirement of these mPOIs.
* Most importantly mPOIs inside Super Earth [[Cities| colonial cities]] / urban settlement zones are only marked as a mPOI if there is at least a Sample, Support Weapon, or a Special Loot container (including bunkers).
** E.G. Shipping container area / customs will only be marked as a mPOI if there is a lootable (shipping) container.

The above rules however only affect the colonial / offworld cities: [[Mega City]] / [[Super Earth Metropolis]]-mPOI-generation works for the most part identically to other non-City mPOIs. I.E. the Mega City mPOI-assets are fully tied to the mPOI itself and cannot exist as non-mPOI, even if they exist as a "scenery-prop" akin to empty "[[Ground Stash]]"-mPOIs. These fabricators will continuously deploy new [[Trooper]]s and their variants until the structure runs out of troopers or is destroyed. == Anatomy == {{Anatomy Table| {{Anatomy Row | part_name = Main | health = 1,500 | av = 5 | front_image = Automaton Fabricator Main Front.png | side_image = Automaton Fabricator Main Side.png | rear_image = Automaton Fabricator Main Rear.png | durability = 100% | percent_to_main = - | bleed = None | fatal = Yes | exdr = 0% | df=40 }} {{Anatomy Row | part_name = Vents | health = - | front_image = Automaton Fabricator Vent.png | durability = N/A | percent_to_main = - | bleed = None | fatal = Yes | exdr = 0% | df=20 if {{Damage|Explosion||notext}} }} |df=yes}} == Tactical Information == *{{PAGENAME}}s can be destroyed via vent by using grenades or explosive primary/support weapons with a '''minimum demolition force''' of '''20 or higher''', from the outside by using attacks with a demolition force of '''40+''', or repeated strikes with an armor penetration of {{Armor|5|AP}} or higher(i.e. [[FAF-14 Spear]], [[Eagle Strafing Run]], etc.). ** Helldivers are advised to target the upper parts or the roof of Fabricators when attempting to demolish through the outer shell; the amount of debris and miniature/foundation walls around Fabricators often blocks the explosions. ** A [[GP-20 Ultimatum]] direct hit, [[TED-63 Dynamite]] or a [[Hellpod]] will destroy a Fabricator on impact. ** A [[Helldiver]] getting out of a Hellpod will be protected from the Fabricator explosion during the deployment animation. ** A Fabricator can also get destroyed by [[Cannon Turret]] shots, [[Reinforced Scout Strider]] rockets, as well as lucky hits during [[Meteor Storms]] and [[Volcanic Activity]] hazards. *Upon destruction, the fabricator will explode with a large amount of force, ragdolling, damaging, or killing any [[Enemies]] or Helldivers nearby. == Bulk Fabricator == The [[Bulk Fabricator]] can be found in Automaton Outposts in [[cities]]. Instead of deploying Troopers, it will deploy [[Devastator]]s, [[Berserker]]s, [[Scout Strider]]s, and even [[Hulk]], [[Tank]]s, and [[War Strider]]s. It is much bigger than standard Automaton Fabricators and has a much higher height. Its weakpoints remain the same: the upper part, where there are two massive vents. == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.002.001|changes= Undocumented Change * Fabricator Explosion demolition force reduced from 50 to 40. }} {{Change History Update|1.001.100|changes= Changes * Automaton Fabricators now have health and armor in addition to their existing destruction system. This means that while many high armor penetration weapons can still destroy them, it may take multiple hits to do so, depending on the weapon used. * Added effects to clearer showcase their health state. * Main health set to 1,500. * Armor set to {{Armor|5|AV}} }} [[Category:Automatons]] {{Nav Enemy}}

'''Detector Tower''' is an [[Missions#Tactical Objectives|Optional Objective]] exclusive to the {{Automaton|text}}, consisting of a large, rotating surveillance tower that will summon reinforcements if it detects the presence of Helldivers. To complete the objective, Helldivers must destroy the tower.

== Objective Steps ==
* Destroy Automaton Detector Tower
** The [[NUX-223 Hellbomb]] will be available to call down when near the tower.
* Rewards: {{Currency|Requisition|200}}, {{Currency|Experience|50}}

== Tactical Information<!-- Old version mentioned "active Hellpod-stratagems" as being valid Detector Tower targets as well, confused if this means sentries/emplacements -->==

* The Detector Tower has a 150-meter range in which it can detect Helldivers, within its distinctive red vision cone.
** The position of the vision cone means that Helldivers that are very close to the Detector Tower cannot be spotted.
** Going prone will render Helldivers completely invisible to the Detector Tower.
* If a Helldiver is spotted, the tower will sound an audible alarm and begin summoning constant waves of bot drops until it can no longer see any Helldivers.
** [[Dropship|Dropships]] spawned in this manner will deploy their units on the last known position of the Helldiver.
* The [[Demolition]] requirement of 50 means that a Hellbomb is unnecessary if alternate options are available.
** Common examples include the [[Eagle 500kg Bomb]], [[Orbital Precision Strike]] and [[SEAF Artillery]] shells.
** Clever positioning can trick [[Cannon Turret|Cannon Turrets]] into destroying the Detector Tower with their shots.
* The Hellbomb's large AOE means that it can be called down far away from the Detector Tower (where one is at little risk of being spotted) and still complete the objective.
* Detector Towers will occasionally spawn inside of [[Automaton Outpost|Fortresses]]. They function identically to standard Detector Towers, but the Hellbomb will '''not''' be available to call down to destroy them. They are also not mandatory to destroy to mark the Fortress as "cleared".

== Trivia ==

* Due to the Tower's distinctive appearance, it is often colloquially referred to as the [[wikipedia:en:Lord of the Rings|'Eye of Sauron']] by many Helldivers.
* Detector Towers can be used to farm Automaton kills for [[Major Orders]], as their alarm state bypasses the global cooldown of bot flares, allowing a constant stream of incoming [[Dropship|Dropships]].

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an Optional Objective contained within an [[Automatons|Automaton]] structure. For as long as it is standing, it disables the ability for Helldivers within 150m to call down any [[Stratagems|Stratagem]] '''except''' for [[SEAF Artillery]]. To complete the Objective, Helldivers must destroy the structure.

== Objective Steps ==
* Destroy Automaton Stratagem Jammer.
** If SEAF Artillery is available, Mini-Nuke & High-Yield Explosive can hit nearby, while Explosive, Napalm, Static Field & Smoke shells must hit the jammer directly to destroy it. This can be done while the jammer is either active or disabled.
** Helldivers must interact with the terminal at the base of the Jammer to disable it, then call in a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb|Hellbomb]] or a Stratagem with minimum [[Demolition|demolition force]] of '''50''' of their choosing to destroy it.
* Reward: {{Currency| Requisition Slips|200}} & {{Currency|Experience|50}}

== Tactical Information ==
* The building that needs to be demolished requires a demolition force of '''50''', which means it can be destroyed by other means than a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb]].
* A recommended tactic is to fire the [[MS-11 Solo Silo]] at the jammer to wipe out any static enemies within the outpost to facilitate the raid into the structure.
* Should the entire squad perish within the range of Stratagem Jammer, the [[Reinforce]] stratagem will be automatically deployed by the edge of the jamming radius, towards the center of the mission area.
* A smart tactic some Helldivers use is to bait a [[Cannon Turret|Cannon Turrets]], [[Annihilator Tank|Annihilator Tanks]], [[Factory Strider|Factory Striders]], or [[Vox Engine|Vox Engines]] into shooting them with the structure behind them, but taking cover immediately so they will shoot and destroy the structure as their powerful lasers have a demolition force of 50.
** The [[Eagle 500kg Bomb]], [[Orbital Precision Strike]], [[Orbital 120mm HE Barrage]], [[Orbital 380mm HE Barrage]], or [[Orbital Walking Barrage]] can be used destroy the jammer when it is deactivated.
*** Additionally The [[Orbital Gas Strike]], [[Orbital EMS Strike]], [[Orbital Smoke Strike]] and [[Orbital Railcannon Strike]] all have the capacity to destroy the jammer, requiring a direct hit.
** SEAF Artillery: Mini-Nuke, High-Yield Explosive, Explosive, Napalm, Smoke and Static Field as well as the [[B-100 Portable Hellbomb]] can destroy the jammer '''without''' disabling it.
*** Napalm, Smoke & Static Field require a direct hit.
* If any stratagem balls are thrown into the range of the jammer, they will neither activate nor enter into a cooldown period.
* Throwing the Stratagem ball of the [[Orbital Walking Barrage]] just outside of the Jammer's radius will still allow the barrages shells to land inside the jammers range. If the barrage is faced directly towards the jammer, it is even possible to destroy it (albeit slowly) with the last few shells.
* It is possible for multiple jammers to spawn within the 150m jamming range of each other. This means that to destroy them, you must interact with the terminals of both of them to disable both jammers before Helldivers can call in a NUX-223 Hellbomb to destroy them, use a [[B-100 Portable Hellbomb]] to destroy one so the other can be destroyed by either mission hellbomb or other demo 50 stratagems or use SEAF Artillery.

== Trivia ==
* The stratagem disabling effect applied while under its area of influence is called "Electronic Countermeasures", a name shared with a [[Electronic Countermeasures|retired Operation Modifier]].
